trap.label: família de palavras
trap.why: Português “significativo”; o brasileiro cria significative. Em inglês: signify, significant, significance.

fix.wrong: The significant of this is huge.
fix.right: The significance of this is huge.

rewrite.prompt: Use o verbo: “The sign means a real effect.” (signifies)
rewrite.answer: The sign signifies a real effect.

rewrite.prompt: Use o substantivo: “It is of great … (significant)”
